Subject: SIG questionnaire initiation - Brightwell Health / follow-up from discovery call

Hi Alex / Priya -

Thanks again for taking the time today - really appreciate the detailed walkthrough of your integration and the risk profile. As discussed, the next step on our side is to initiate the vendor questionnaire so your security team can validate technical + operational controls.

I’ve attached the fillable SIG Lite (SIG-v1.7) to this thread - we typically complete the first pass on items we own and then flag questions back to your team. To help speed things up, a few clarifying notes from our call: 

- SOC 2: We are happy to provide our SOC 2 report or a readiness summary - please confirm if you require SOC 2 Type II or Type I.
- HIPAA/BAA: Redwood offers HIPAA protections on Dedicated and Private deployments; we can sign a BAA for those deployments. For hosted API usage, we can discuss options - please confirm your expected deployment mode.
- Data residency / retention: please confirm if Brightwell requires EU/region-specific residency or strict retention windows.
- KMS / encryption: we support customer-managed keys for Private deployments; for hosted API we use managed KMS and can provide key management details in the questionnaire.

Next steps I propose:
1) I’ll upload a completed baseline for the SIG (items we can answer today) and tag open items.
2) Marissa (cc'd) - our Security PM - will own any technical deep dives.
3) Can you confirm target completion date for your team (we typically see 7-10 business days)?

I’ll start filling the SIG and circle back with the initial pass by EOD tomorrow. Let me know if there are any custom forms or vendor portals you prefer instead of SIG.

Best,

Camila Reyes

Date: Mon, 10 Jan 2027 16:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SIG questionnaire initiation - Brightwell Health / follow-up from discovery call

Thanks Camila - really helpful. A couple quick clarifying items from our security/compliance team so we can prioritize the right reviewers: 

1) SOC 2: We require SOC 2 Type II for vendors that handle PHI; if you have Type II completed, please share the report or an AOC. If you are still in progress, please share expected completion date and any interim artifacts (SOC 2 readiness summary, gap remediation plan).
2) BAA / HIPAA: Brightwell will need to sign a BAA if PHI is processed. Can you confirm whether Redwood will sign a BAA for Hosted API or only for Dedicated/Private?
3) Data residency: We need to ensure US-only hosting for PHI. Does Redwood offer region restriction for hosted customers or would we need Private/Dedicated?
4) Encryption & KMS: Can you outline whether keys are customer-controlled or Redwood-managed and whether bring-your-own-key is possible for hosted?
5) Timeline: target to complete questionnaires and internal review by Jan 20. Is that feasible?

If useful we can share our security contact's Slack/email for a short triage call - we typically align on a 30-min walkthrough.

Thanks - Alex
Director of IT Security | Brightwell Health
alex.turner@brightwellhealth.com | +1 (617) 555-3321
From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>

Date: Tue, 11 Jan 2027 09:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SIG questionnaire initiation - Brightwell Health / follow-up from discovery call

Hi Alex / Priya -

Great questions - below are short answers and next steps. I’ll fill the SIG baseline this morning and mark any items that need deeper input. Marissa, can you pick up the technical follow-ups after I push the initial pass?

1) SOC 2: Redwood completed SOC 2 Type II in Oct 2026 (most recent AOC available). I’ve attached a summary to our internal doc link and will include the AOC in the SIG where allowed. If you need the full report we can provide it under an NDA - let us know.
2) BAA / HIPAA: We DO sign BAAs. For Hosted API customers we have a documented set of controls and limited HIPAA support; however, for PHI workloads we recommend Dedicated or Private deployments where we can provide a full BAA. We’ll flag BAA items in the SIG and Marissa can confirm the exact scoping options.
3) Data residency: Hosted API is multi-region; we offer region pinning and private deployments guarantee residency. For strict US-only PHI hosting we recommend Private or Dedicated - we’ll note the options in the questionnaire.
4) Encryption & KMS: Encryption at rest and in transit is standard. Customer-managed keys are supported for Private deployments and Dedicated via BYOK integrations (AWS KMS/HSM). Hosted API uses Redwood-managed KMS but we can share details and encryption certs in the SIG.
5) Timeline: Jan 20 is reasonable. I’ll send the initial SIG pass today, and Marissa can coordinate any deeper technical evidence or scans.

Would it help to schedule a 30-minute call between your security team and Marissa to triage the open items? I’m happy to set that up for tomorrow or Thursday.

Thanks - looking forward to moving this forward.

Best,

Camila Reyes
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
camila.reyes@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0183
